# Is the post office closed today on Veterans Day 2026? Will mail be delivered?
* Published: Nov. 11, 2026, 10:29 a.m.
The post office will be closed on Veterans Day 2026, and USPS mail delivery will not run in observance of the federal holiday. Jim Lowney | For NJ Advance Media
By
* Katherine Rodriguez | NJ.com
Veterans Day 2026 is observed on Wednesday, Nov. 11, and is a designated federal holiday.
Because of this, several federal and state offices will be closed and services will not be running.
The post office and its mail delivery service traditionally do not run on federal holidays, but private services tend to run on their own schedules.
Here is everything you need to know about the post office, mail delivery, FedEx, Amazon fulfillment and UPS on Veterans Day 2026.
## Is the post office closed on Veterans Day 2026?
The United States Postal Service offices will be closed on Nov. 11, the same way most banks are closed on the holiday.
It’s best to plan ahead and visit a location before or after Wednesday to avoid any mailing issues.
## Does the mail run on Veterans Day 2026? Is there mail delivery?
There will be no regular mail delivery from USPS on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
People expecting mail on Wednesday should plan for a one-day delay.
## Will FedEx, Amazon and UPS be delivering on Veterans Day 2026?
FedEx will deliver on a modified schedule on Nov. 11.
However, most other services will be running as usual, including FedEx Office, FedEx Custom Critical and FedEx logistics.
UPS will still make deliveries, and the company’s stores will remain open.
However, certain deliveries, such as UPS Ground Saver and UPS Mail Innovations, may take an extra business day in transit due to the federal (USPS) holiday, according to the UPS website.
Amazon will still make deliveries on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
